name: io.github.berkingurcan/stellar-agent-search
title: Stellar Agent Search
description: Discover and rank Stellar 8004 agents with a read-only MCP server and fail-closed contract probes.

environmentVariables.name: STELLAR_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Stellar network to target: mainnet | testnet. testnet also requires EXPLORER_BASE_URL or REGISTRY_AGENT_IDS — the default explorer indexes mainnet only, and the server refuses to start with neither.

environmentVariables.name: EXPLORER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the stellar-8004 explorer API base URL.

environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_AGENT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Registry mode: comma-separated agent ids read straight from the Identity contract, with no explorer. Tools that need an indexer return INDEXER_REQUIRED. Not combinable with EXPLORER_BASE_URL.

environmentVariables.name: TRUSTED_VALIDATORS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated G… or C… addresses of the verifiers whose Validation Registry records earn Provider Standard badges in get_provider_manifest. Empty: the registry is not read.

environmentVariables.name: STELLAR_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Soroban RPC URL used for the bounded Reputation-contract probe.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY_ONCHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to skip the bounded contract probe; reputation fields remain Explorer-declared either way.
